title: A near-autonomous AI chemist improves a challenging reaction in medicinal chemistry
summary_lines: OpenAI and Molecule.one show how a near-autonomous AI chemist using GPT-5.4 improved a key drug-making reaction, advancing medicinal chemistry research.
